notes: RBox revision of symmetry. Modification is a head-dependent relation: the modifier depends on the head, never the other way round, so 'modifies' is asymmetric; the edit changes that property to symmetric. The three propositional queries are a negation, a conjunction with a true side fact and a disjunction with a false one. The second instance asks whether the given fact rules out the converse (yes, then no) so the topic's RBox yes and no answers balance. Instance facts are stated in the prompt. Caveat: the edit adds symmetry to a relation that was asymmetric (asymmetry is otherwise unused as a property; the paired contraction grammar-delete-0010 removes it). Near asks the same property of 'is a constituent of' (reference no, differs from the new yes); far a transitive comparison. Locality references are the logical answers; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
